reviews.title: GREAT RGB FANS FOR THE PRICE
reviews.comment: I bought these fans to use as base intake fans to help with the cooling of my RTX 5070 video card. These fans are exactly like the ones that came with my prebuilt. They daisy chained very easily and synced perfectly with the rest of my fans. Installation was a breeze and they look absolutely fabulous while producing a good amount of air flow. They make them with regular rotation as well as reverse style so you can have the pretty RGB side facing upwards while sucking the air into the case. The base fans in the picture are reverse style. Love this product.
reviews.author: Rick Vaughn

reviews.title: Misleading but decent quality
reviews.comment: These aren't as advertised as they don't link up like it shows and they aren't able to connect with wires that make it just another fan with a plug in to the motherboard, they look nice and look cools but not as advertised.
reviews.author: Andrew Karlzen

reviews.title: Make sure you select the correct product
reviews.comment: Hard to tell which fan has which features. Same description no matter which fan you select. Thought I was getting the fans that attach to each other and only have one cable. That is not at all what I got. EVERY fan has multiple cables.
reviews.author: Aaron J.

reviews.title: Sopla ciclón, sopla.
reviews.comment: Cumple su cometido, y vienen individuales. Yo pensé que venía una sola pieza con un único conector para los tres ventiladores, y no... Cada ventilador viene separado con su conector. De igual manera me gustó.
